title: Processing a partial buffer segment
statement: Let $\sigma$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $w,j$ be natural numbers, let $\delta : \sigma \to \mathrm{List}(\alpha) \to \sigma$, and let $l$ be a list over $\alpha$. Suppose $j+|l|\le w$. Starting from state $s$, position $j$, and any buffer of $w+1$ entries, folding the update operation over $l$ leaves the state equal to $s$ and advances the position to $j+|l|$. There is a resulting buffer whose entry at each position $t$ with $j\le t<j+|l|$ is the entry of $l$ at index $t-j$.
hypotheses_covered: the initial buffer maps the $w+1$ positions to elements of $\alpha$
